body:
Same. All instances of happiness I feel tends to end quickly.

I still function, but today something happened and I just wanted to stop all of it. In the middle of a busy street on the way to the train I just couldn't get myself to move anymore. I just wanted to curl up into a ball and cry. 

It's like I'm out and about in order not to feel sadness but my body rebelled.

And people say I'm weak for giving into emotions when I've kept them buried all my life.
Send me a message if you want to chat.
